launch.method: Pushed after every gate passed, then verified against the LIVE site rather than the push: /status.json returned the pushed commit, / returned 200 carrying the site title, and /wiki/concept/ai-winter rendered. A successful push and a deployed site are different claims.

gates.measure-payload: 109.3 KB gzipped against a 150 KB budget

analytics_live.method: Playwright/Chromium against the deployed site. Assertions are on captured /g/collect requests and their response status (HTTP 204), never on markup — markup rendering a gtag loader is not evidence that an event was delivered, which is the precise failure mode of the previous site. This also confirms NEXT_PUBLIC_GA_MEASUREMENT_ID is set in the Vercel project: Vercel rebuilds from source on push, so a missing env var would have produced a live build with no analytics while every local check still passed.

analytics_realtime.method: GA4 property -> Reports -> Realtime, per specs/analytics: visit the live site and click through to a second page, then see at least one active user and both page_views within five minutes. This is the one check no agent can perform — it requires a signed-in browser on the GA property — so it is recorded as the maintainer's own observation, not as a measurement taken here.
analytics_realtime.corroborated_by: scripts/verify-analytics.mjs against https://www.addictedtoai.net: 20 assertions, 0 failures, asserted on captured /g/collect POSTs returning HTTP 204 rather than on markup. Independent of the Realtime view and agreeing with it.
